science.explanation: The Spinny Stabilizer Site is a web-based platform designed to provide real-time stabilization and control for spinning objects.
assumptions: The system will operate within a controlled environment with minimal external interference.
The spinning objects will be accurately modeled using physics engines.

diagrams.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
participant Spinny Stabilizer Site as SSS
participant Spinning Object as SO
note over SSS: Receive sensor data from SO
SSS->>SO: Send control signal to SO
SO->>SSS: Update stabilization parameters
diagrams.caption: Spinny Stabilizer Site Control Loop

citations.title: Real-Time Stabilization of Spinning Objects using Machine Learning

citations.title: Physics Engine for Simulating Spinning Objects
citations.snippet: This paper introduces a physics engine designed to simulate the behavior of spinning objects with high accuracy.

citations.title: Stabilization and Control of Spinning Objects using Feedback Loops
